# Services of the API: every class of src/ is a service, wired by its constructor.
parameters:
    env(API_KEYS): ''

services:
    _defaults:
        autowire: true
        autoconfigure: true
        bind:
            $apiKeys: '%env(API_KEYS)%'

    App\:
        resource: '../src/'
        exclude: '../src/Kernel.php'

    # Each repository keeps its items in the database with Doctrine
    App\Repository\CustomerRepository: '@App\Repository\DoctrineCustomerRepository'
    App\Repository\ProductRepository: '@App\Repository\DoctrineProductRepository'
    App\Repository\OrderRepository: '@App\Repository\DoctrineOrderRepository'

```bash
php bin/console doctrine:schema:create
php -S localhost:8000 -t public
```

The API listens on http://localhost:8000. Its contract is in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
composer test
```

The tests use an in-memory SQLite database, or the one in `TEST_DATABASE_URL` (`postgresql://` or `mysql://`).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/customers` | List customers | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/customers/{id}` | Get a customer | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/customers` | Create a customer | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/customers/{id}` | Replace a customer | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/customers/{id}` | Update part of a customer | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/customers/{id}` | Delete a customer | 204 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/products` | List products | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/products/{id}` | Get a product | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/products` | Create a product | 201 | authenticated |

| `PATCH` | `/products/{id}` | Update part of a product | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/products/{id}` | Delete a product | 204 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/orders` | List orders | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/orders/{id}` | Get an order | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/orders` | Create an order | 201 | authenticated |

| `PATCH` | `/orders/{id}` | Update part of an order | 200 | authenticated |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

Doctrine ORM on sqlite. `php bin/console doctrine:schema:create` creates the tables while you develop; for a real database, use migrations (Model2DB writes them). Embedded objects and lists are stored as JSON columns, and references as key columns.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints need a key in the `X-API-Key` header, one of the comma-separated keys in `API_KEYS`. Without `API_KEYS`, every protected request is rejected.

<?php

namespace App\Controller;

use App\Exception\ApiException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\JsonResponse;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\Uid\Uuid;

/**
 * Base of the controllers. Keys in paths and values in query strings are text: they are read with their type,
 * and a malformed one is a 400, not a missing item.
 */
abstract class ApiController
{
    protected function integerKey(Request $request, string $name): int
    {
        $value = (string) $request->attributes->get($name);
        if (preg_match('/^-?\d+$/', $value) !== 1) {
            throw ApiException::invalid($name, 'Must be a whole number');
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }

    protected function uuidKey(Request $request, string $name): string
    {
        $value = (string) $request->attributes->get($name);
        if (! Uuid::isValid($value)) {
            throw ApiException::invalid($name, 'Must be a UUID');
        }

        return $value;
    }

    protected function textKey(Request $request, string $name): string
    {
        return (string) $request->attributes->get($name);
    }

    /** A whole number of the query string, within its limits; the default when it is not there. */
    protected function integerQuery(Request $request, string $name, ?int $default = null, ?int $min = null, ?int $max = null): ?int
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if ($value === null) {
            return $default;
        }
        if (preg_match('/^-?\d+$/', $value) !== 1 || ($min !== null && (int) $value < $min) || ($max !== null && (int) $value > $max)) {
            throw ApiException::invalid($name, 'Must be a whole number within its limits');
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }

    protected function numberQuery(Request $request, string $name): ?float
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if ($value !== null && ! is_numeric($value)) {
            throw ApiException::invalid($name, 'Must be a number');
        }

        return $value === null ? null : (float) $value;
    }

    protected function booleanQuery(Request $request, string $name): ?bool
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if ($value !== null && ! in_array($value, ['true', 'false'], true)) {
            throw ApiException::invalid($name, 'Must be true or false');
        }

        return $value === null ? null : $value === 'true';
    }

    /**
     * A value of the query string that must be one of $choices, compared as text.
     *
     * @param  list<string|int>  $choices
     */
    protected function choiceQuery(Request $request, string $name, array $choices): string|int|null
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if ($value === null) {
            return null;
        }
        foreach ($choices as $choice) {
            if ((string) $choice === $value) {
                return $choice;
            }
        }
        throw ApiException::invalid($name, 'Must be one of: '.implode(', ', $choices));
    }

    /** Text of the query string that matches $pattern, when one is given. */
    protected function textQuery(Request $request, string $name, ?string $pattern = null): ?string
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if ($value !== null && $pattern !== null && preg_match($pattern, $value) !== 1) {
            throw ApiException::invalid($name, 'Has the wrong format');
        }

        return $value;
    }

    protected function answer(mixed $data, int $status): JsonResponse
    {
        return new JsonResponse($data, $status);
    }

    protected function empty(int $status): Response
    {
        return new Response(null, $status);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\EventSubscriber;

use App\Exception\ApiException;
use App\Exception\NotImplementedException;
use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;
use Symfony\Component\EventDispatcher\EventSubscriberInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\JsonResponse;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Event\ExceptionEvent;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\MethodNotAllowedHttpException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\NotFoundHttpException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\KernelEvents;

/** Answers every error with the body of openapi.yaml: {"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}. */
final class ApiErrorSubscriber implements EventSubscriberInterface
{
    public function __construct(private readonly ?LoggerInterface $logger = null)
    {
    }

    public static function getSubscribedEvents(): array
    {
        return [KernelEvents::EXCEPTION => 'onException'];
    }

    public function onException(ExceptionEvent $event): void
    {
        $error = $event->getThrowable();
        $event->setResponse(match (true) {
            $error instanceof ApiException => self::answer($error->status, $error->errorCode, $error->getMessage(), $error->details),
            $error instanceof NotImplementedException => self::answer(501, 'not_implemented', $error->getMessage() ?: 'The logic of this operation is not written yet'),
            $error instanceof NotFoundHttpException => self::answer(404, 'not_found', 'No route matches this request'),
            $error instanceof MethodNotAllowedHttpException => self::answer(405, 'method_not_allowed', 'This path does not accept this method'),
            default => $this->unexpected($error),
        });
    }

    /** @param list<array{field: string, message: string}> $details */
    public static function answer(int $status, string $code, string $message, array $details = []): JsonResponse
    {
        $error = ['code' => $code, 'message' => $message];
        if ($details !== []) {
            $error['details'] = $details;
        }

        return new JsonResponse(['error' => $error], $status);
    }

    private function unexpected(\Throwable $error): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->logger?->error($error->getMessage(), ['exception' => $error]);

        return self::answer(500, 'internal_error', 'Something went wrong on the server');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http;

use App\Exception\ApiException;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\Validator\Constraint;
use Symfony\Component\Validator\Validator\ValidatorInterface;

/**
 * Reads the body of a request: it must be a JSON object and meet the constraints of the request, which reject
 * fields the contract does not describe (openapi.yaml, additionalProperties: false).
 */
final class JsonBody
{
    public function __construct(private readonly ValidatorInterface $validator)
    {
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> The body, checked */
    public function read(Request $request, Constraint $constraint): array
    {
        $content = $request->getContent();
        try {
            $body = json_decode($content === '' ? 'null' : $content, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (\JsonException) {
            throw new ApiException(400, 'validation_error', 'The body is not valid JSON');
        }
        if (! is_array($body) || (array_is_list($body) && $body !== [])) {
            throw new ApiException(400, 'validation_error', 'The body must be a JSON object');
        }
        $details = [];
        foreach ($this->validator->validate($body, $constraint) as $violation) {
            // [address][street] is address.street, as in the other answers
            $field = trim(str_replace('][', '.', $violation->getPropertyPath()), '[]');
            $details[] = ['field' => $field, 'message' => (string) $violation->getMessage()];
        }
        if ($details !== []) {
            throw new ApiException(400, 'validation_error', 'The request is not valid', $details);
        }

        return $body;
    }
}

namespace App\Repository;

use App\Entity\Customer;
use App\Support\ListQuery;
use App\Support\ListResult;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;

/** Keeps customers in the database with Doctrine. */
final class DoctrineCustomerRepository implements CustomerRepository
{
    /** The entity property of each JSON field */
    private const PROPERTIES = [
        'id' => 'id',
        'name' => 'name',
        'email' => 'email',
        'password' => 'password',
        'phone' => 'phone',
        'address' => 'address',
        'createdAt' => 'createdAt',
    ];

    public function __construct(private readonly EntityManagerInterface $manager)
    {
    }

    public function list(ListQuery $query): ListResult
    {
        $builder = $this->manager->createQueryBuilder()->select('item')->from(Customer::class, 'item');
        $index = 0;
        foreach ($query->filters as $field => $value) {
            $parameter = 'filter'.$index++;
            $builder->andWhere('item.'.self::PROPERTIES[$field].' = :'.$parameter)->setParameter($parameter, $this->toProperty($field, $value));
        }
        $total = (int) (clone $builder)->select('COUNT(item)')->getQuery()->getSingleScalarResult();
        if ($query->sortField !== null) {
            $sorted = 'item.'.self::PROPERTIES[$query->sortField];
            // Items without a value go last, whatever the order
            $builder->addSelect("CASE WHEN {$sorted} IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HIDDEN missing")
                ->addOrderBy('missing', 'ASC')
                ->addOrderBy($sorted, $query->descending ? 'DESC' : 'ASC');
        }
        $builder->addOrderBy('item.id', 'ASC')->setFirstResult($query->offset);
        if ($query->limit !== null) {
            $builder->setMaxResults($query->limit);
        }

        return new ListResult(array_map($this->toItem(...), $builder->getQuery()->getResult()), $total);
    }

    public function get(int $key): ?array
    {
        $entity = $this->manager->find(Customer::class, $key);

        return $entity === null ? null : $this->toItem($entity);
    }

    public function add(array $item): array
    {
        $entity = new Customer();
        $this->fill($entity, $item);
        $this->manager->persist($entity);
        $this->manager->flush();
        // Read back, so the answer has what the database keeps (dates without fractions of a second)
        $this->manager->refresh($entity);

        return $this->toItem($entity);
    }

    public function save(int $key, array $item): array
    {
        $entity = $this->manager->find(Customer::class, $key);
        $this->fill($entity, $item);
        $this->manager->flush();
        $this->manager->refresh($entity);

        return $this->toItem($entity);
    }

    public function delete(int $key): void
    {
        $entity = $this->manager->find(Customer::class, $key);
        if ($entity !== null) {
            $this->manager->remove($entity);
            $this->manager->flush();
        }
    }

    /** Every field but the key takes the value of the item; a field left out is null. */
    private function fill(Customer $entity, array $item): void
    {
        $entity->name = $item['name'] ?? null;
        $entity->email = $item['email'] ?? null;
        $entity->password = $item['password'] ?? null;
        $entity->phone = $item['phone'] ?? null;
        $entity->address = $item['address'] ?? null;
        $entity->createdAt = ($item['createdAt'] ?? null) === null ? null : (new \DateTimeImmutable($item['createdAt'] ?? null))->setTimezone(new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));
    }

    /** The value a filter compares, as the entity holds it. */
    private function toProperty(string $field, mixed $value): mixed
    {
        return match ($field) {
            'createdAt' => $value === null ? null : (new \DateTimeImmutable($value))->setTimezone(new \DateTimeZone('UTC')),
            default => $value,
        };
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */

    {
        return [

        $valid = array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', $this->apiKeys)), fn (string $known) => $known !== '' && hash_equals($known, $key));

            throw ApiException::unauthorized();
        }
    }
}

namespace App\Support;

/** What a list asks a repository for: equality filters by JSON field name, an order and a window of items. */
final class ListQuery
{
    /** @param array<string, mixed> $filters */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly array $filters = [],
        public readonly ?string $sortField = null,
        public readonly bool $descending = false,
        public readonly int $offset = 0,
        public readonly ?int $limit = null,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * "-createdAt" sorts by createdAt in descending order.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $filters
     */
    public static function of(array $filters, ?string $sort, int $offset = 0, ?int $limit = null): self
    {
        if ($sort === null || $sort === '') {
            return new self($filters, null, false, $offset, $limit);
        }
        $descending = str_starts_with($sort, '-');

        return new self($filters, $descending ? substr($sort, 1) : $sort, $descending, $offset, $limit);
    }
}

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->client = static::createClient();
        // One application for the whole test, so what a request stores the next one reads
        $this->client->disableReboot();
        $manager = static::getContainer()->get('doctrine.orm.entity_manager');
        $metadata = $manager->getMetadataFactory()->getAllMetadata();
        $tool = new SchemaTool($manager);
        // Empty tables for each test
        $tool->dropSchema($metadata);
        $tool->createSchema($metadata);
    }

    /**
     * Sends a request with a JSON body.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     * @param  array<string, string>  $headers
     */
    protected function json(string $method, string $uri, array $data = [], array $headers = []): TestResponse
    {
        $server = ['CONTENT_TYPE' => 'application/json', 'HTTP_ACCEPT' => 'application/json'];
        foreach ($headers as $name => $value) {
            $server['HTTP_'.strtoupper(str_replace('-', '_', $name))] = $value;
        }
        $this->client->request($method, $uri, [], [], $server, json_encode($data, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));

        return new TestResponse($this->client->getResponse());
    }

namespace App\Tests;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Assert;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/** The answer of a request in a test: its status, and its JSON body or a value inside it ("error.code"). */
final class TestResponse
{
    public function __construct(private readonly Response $response)
    {
    }

    public function assertStatus(int $status): void
    {
        Assert::assertSame($status, $this->response->getStatusCode(), (string) $this->response->getContent());
    }

    public function json(?string $path = null): mixed
    {
        $value = json_decode((string) $this->response->getContent(), true);
        foreach ($path === null ? [] : explode('.', $path) as $part) {
            $value = is_array($value) ? ($value[$part] ?? null) : null;
        }

        return $value;
    }
}
